HOME SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Meal Service? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Meal Service.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Meal Service.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Meal Service.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Meal Service.

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cake Making and Decoration? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cake Making and Decoration.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cake Making and Decoration.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cake Making and Decoration.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cake Making and Decoration.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

9. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Preservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Preservation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Preservation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Preservation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Food Preservation.

11. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. watt (W)

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Planning Family Meals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Planning Family Meals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Planning Family Meals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Planning Family Meals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Planning Family Meals.
